frontier.hypothesis: Split-init / staged-value the shared complete_store so the final OR result register naturally lands in $v1 (matching target) EVEN with per-arm var_v1 mask compute — breaking the H1e coupling
frontier.mechanism: target's shared block ends `or v1,v1,v0; sw v1`. If C is written so var_v1 holds the mask and the final OR is `var_v1 = var_v1 | ((var_v0 & 7) << 13); D_800A34F8 = var_v1;`, GCC may keep result in $v1 (reusing var_v1's register), preserving the sw-source-reg divergence H1d relies on while ALSO forcing per-arm mask compute.

If GCC compiles two paths with same var_v0 with the +1 vs -1 as the delta right before the join, the merge naturally lands at target's boundary.
